resume_text: Arjun Sharma | B.Tech CSE NIT Karnataka | Skills: React, JavaScript, Python, FastAPI, Tailwind CSS, Git | Projects: DevFlow (Collaborative code editor), Campus Placement Platform | Experience: Frontend Developer Intern at TechStart Labs

roles.title: Frontend Developer Intern
roles.why: Excellent match with core React, JavaScript, modern CSS, and component design patterns.
roles.sample_jd: We are looking for an ambitious Frontend Developer Intern at a hyper-growth Indian startup. You will collaborate with product designers and fullstack engineers to create intuitive, blazing-fast web experiences using React and modern CSS. You will integrate REST APIs, maintain responsive layout fidelity, and participate in peer code reviews.

roles.title: Junior Full-Stack Engineer (React + Python)
roles.why: Strong project portfolio demonstrating end-to-end web apps with FastAPI and React.
roles.sample_jd: Seeking a Junior Full-Stack Engineer to build customer-facing dashboards and microservices. Must have proven hands-on experience with React frontend and Python (FastAPI/Django) backend, schema design, and asynchronous API architectures.
roles.search_query: Junior Full Stack Engineer React Python

roles.title: Junior UI/UX Frontend Developer
roles.why: Demonstrated flair for clean responsive UI, CSS design systems, and rapid prototyping.
roles.sample_jd: Join our product design engineering squad. You will translate Figma mockups into reusable React components, author fluid animations, and ensure cross-browser pixel precision across mobile and desktop devices.

roles.title: React Native Mobile App Intern
roles.why: Strong React fundamentals and component state lifecycle map directly to React Native development.
roles.sample_jd: Looking for a passionate React Native Intern to build slick iOS and Android mobile features. Work alongside mobile leads to craft 60fps animations, integrate device hardware APIs, and streamline offline caching.

roles.title: Software Development Engineer - Frontend (SDE-1)
roles.why: Solid algorithmic foundations and modern web architecture basics; high potential for fast ramp-up.
roles.sample_jd: SDE-1 Frontend position at leading Indian fintech/e-commerce unicorn. You will build highly scalable user journeys serving millions of daily requests with strict uptime, sub-second load times, and rigorous automated testing.
